answer_1.quote: We introduce a challenging new text editing task, wherein a model must learn to edit text in response to a user command...

answer_2.quote: We consider several metrics to evaluate our model. One natural metric to consider is BLEU... We also evaluate model outputs by comparing the word-level edits made by the model against the reference... we compute the precision and F1 score... Finally, we compute sentence-level accuracy...

answer_4.quote: We conducted two rounds of human evaluations, each time across 200 examples from our test set. Annotators were crowd sourced, and each example was rated by seven judges... Judges were asked whether edits were satisfactory and were presented with tasks such as choosing which system better accomplished the command and which was more faithful to the grounding.
answer_4.guideline: Judges compare systems on command fulfillment and grounding faithfulness, and rate satisfaction on a 0‑5 Likert scale.
